name: Kanojo no Ecchi na Katei Kyoushi
original_name: 彼女のエッチな家庭教師
source:
The protagonist takes up home tutoring a girl who hates studying. Intending to scold her, he offers to not force her to study any longer as long as she plays with his dick.

Naturally, she accepted, affirming she would do anything as long as she could avoid studying. And thus, the tutoring turned into a very different, special kind of lesson.
translation:
主角在家辅导一个讨厌学习的女孩。想要骂她，他提出只要她玩他的鸡鸡，就不再强迫她学习。

她自然接受了，并表示只要能逃避学习，她愿意做任何事。因此，辅导变成了一种非常不同、特殊的课程。
